message: Function must return Result[T] — every function must surface success/failure explicitly
rationale: Every function must surface success or failure explicitly in its return type. Result[T] makes the contract visible and statically analyzable. All functions MUST return Result[T] — no exceptions.
remediation: Return a typed Result[T] (or equivalent explicit result type) with success/failure discrimination. Catch local failures and convert them at the boundary of the fallible work.
